shortDescription: Copper declines in Asian trade. Sentiment around base metals was likely weakened by the sell-off in AI-related equities, say ANZ Research analysts in a note. Any reduced spending in the AI sector could weigh on demand for copper, but signs of tightness in China could provide some support, they add…

children: Copper declines in Asian trade. Sentiment around base metals was likely weakened by the sell-off in AI-related equities, say ANZ Research analysts in a note. Any reduced spending in the AI sector could weigh on demand for copper, but signs of tightness in China could provide some support, they add. The three-month copper futures contract on the London Metal Exchange falls 0.8% to $13,295.00 a metric ton. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
